definition: חָצָה verb divide (Late Hebrew id. ; Arabic is be fortunate, happy with one's husband or wife, etc., i.e. have a share in happiness; a small arrow ; Di 134 puts here Ethiopic arrow , compare חֵצִי ) — Qal Perfect חָצָה Num 31:42 וְחָצִיתָ consecutive Num 31:27 וְחָצוּ consecutive Exod 21:35 Imperfect יֶחֱצֶה Isa 30:28 וַיַּ֫חַץ Gen 32:8 + 2 t.; וַיֶּחֱצֵם Judg 9:43 יֶחֱצוּ Ps 55:24 יֶחֱצוּן Exod 21:35 יֶחֱצוּהוּ Job 40:30 — 1. divide , followed by כסף Exod 21:35 שׁור v Exod 21:35 (both J E ), לִוְיָתָן crocodile Job 40:30 prey, מלקוח , Num 31:27 ( P ; with לְ before parts); a company of people Gen 32:8 (followed by לְ as foregoing), Gen 33:1 (both J ) Judg 9:43 ( לְ as foregoing) but compare Judg 7:16 . 2. (apparently denominative from חֲצִי ) Ps 55:24 ימיהם ׳ לא יח shall not halve their days , i.e. enjoy even half of the normal number; Isa 30:28 עד ׳ צואר יח shall halve unto the neck = shall reach to the neck and so divide the man in half. Niph`al Imperfect 3 feminine singular with apocope תֵּחָץ Dan 11:4 be divided (of kingdom), followed by לְ ; ולא יֵחָ֫צוּ עוד לשׁני גוים Ezek 37:22 (Judah and Israel); waters of Jordan 2Kgs 2:8 ; 2Kgs 2:14 .
